extracted.intended_audience: senior researchers preparing applications to Wellcome Discovery / Investigator Awards (established investigators seeking long-term funding)
extracted.subtask_description: Guidance and evaluation criteria for senior researchers applying to Wellcome's flagship Discovery/Investigator awards, focused on proposing ambitious, long-term discovery research programs. Covers selection criteria, EDI requirements, evaluation stages, and funding/format allowances (joint applications, duration, budget).

rubrics_metrics.name: Research Vision and Approach
rubrics_metrics.description: Originality and ambition of the research vision; importance of the questions being addressed; soundness of the proposed approach; potential for transformative outcomes.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Wellcome emphasizes a 'compelling research vision' — applicants should present an ambitious, original program of discovery research that targets important questions and has plausible, sound methods that could lead to transformative outcomes. The scheme favors long-term agendas rather than narrowly scoped, incremental projects.

rubrics_metrics.name: Research Environment
rubrics_metrics.description: Quality of the host institution and team; resources available; track record of training and developing researchers.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Assessors judge whether the host environment and team provide the necessary infrastructure and support for the ambitious program, including institutional capacity for training, mentoring and developing researchers relevant to the project's needs.

rubrics_metrics.name: You as a Researcher
rubrics_metrics.description: Track record relative to career stage; demonstrated ability to lead a major research program; vision and leadership in the field.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Applicants are evaluated on their past achievements appropriate to their career stage and on evidence they can lead and sustain a significant, long-term research agenda. Leadership, field-recognition and ability to build/drive a research program are key.

rubrics_metrics.name: Researcher Inclusion (Equity, Diversity & Inclusion) — General Requirement
rubrics_metrics.description: Applications must address how Equity, Diversity and Inclusion (EDI) considerations factor into the research across planning, development, implementation and dissemination.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Wellcome explicitly requires an application section on EDI. EDI considerations should be appropriate to the proposal context, discipline(s), research location, and team composition. Wellcome treats EDI as a scored/central criterion rather than merely compliance or aspiration.

rubrics_metrics.name: EDI — Research planning
rubrics_metrics.description: Does the research question itself consider equity?
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Describe how the framing of research questions accounts for equity-related issues (for example, whether the question addresses under-served populations or differences across groups) where relevant to the research context.

rubrics_metrics.name: EDI — Research development
rubrics_metrics.description: Are diverse perspectives included in study/design development?
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Explain how diverse viewpoints, knowledge systems or stakeholder inputs were incorporated into experimental design, methods choice, or theory development as appropriate to the discipline and location.

rubrics_metrics.name: EDI — Research implementation
rubrics_metrics.description: Does the project include diverse team composition?
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provide information on team diversity, recruitment, mentoring and capacity-building practices that will promote equitable participation and representation in carrying out the research.

rubrics_metrics.name: EDI — Research dissemination
rubrics_metrics.description: Are outputs accessible to diverse audiences?
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Explain plans to share findings and outputs in ways that reach and are useful to different audiences (e.g., open access, non-technical summaries, local-language dissemination), appropriate to the project context.

rubrics_metrics.name: Stage 1 — Shortlisting (Expert Review Groups)
rubrics_metrics.description: Shortlisting by independent UK and international scientists assessing vision, ambition, and track record to reduce the applicant pool.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Early-stage assessment focuses on the research vision and the applicant's record; applicants should ensure their case for ambition and suitability is clear and prominent in the written submission because it determines shortlisting.

rubrics_metrics.name: Stage 2 — External Peer Review
rubrics_metrics.description: Shortlisted applications are sent to UK and international referees for detailed scientific review; reviewer comments are shared with applicants who may respond.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Applicants should anticipate in-depth critique of scientific approach and design; the process allows applicants to respond to reviewer comments, so addressing potential weaknesses proactively in the application is advantageous.

rubrics_metrics.name: Stage 3 — Selection Panel Interview
rubrics_metrics.description: Shortlisted candidates are invited to interview to present their vision and respond to reviewer concerns; final funding decisions are made at interview.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The interview allows panel members to make holistic judgments beyond the written application — applicants should prepare to articulate long-term vision, justify risk-taking, and address reviewer critiques directly.

rubrics_metrics.name: Joint applications (co-leadership allowed)
rubrics_metrics.description: Joint applications by two researchers with complementary expertise are permitted.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Wellcome welcomes joint/co-lead applications similar to ERC Synergy — teams should demonstrate complementary skills and a coherent shared vision for a combined long-term program.

rubrics_metrics.name: Funding scope and duration
rubrics_metrics.description: Award value up to £3 million (up to £425,000 per year) for up to 7–8 years.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Applicants can design long-term, high-risk programs consistent with multi-year funding and annual budget caps; proposals should align planned activities and milestones with the award's duration and available budget.

rubrics_metrics.name: Distinctive emphasis on long-term, ambitious programs
rubrics_metrics.description: "Compelling research vision" as core criterion — emphasizes long-term agenda over specific project.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Wellcome's scheme is intended to fund an investigator's long-term discovery agenda (time and flexibility to pursue ambitious questions). Applicants should foreground programmatic vision and capacity to pursue unpredictable or high-risk avenues that require extended support.
